_disclaimer: Indicative fine ranges for demo/report-generation purposes only, based on the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 central schedule. State governments have since notified their own revised amounts under Section 200 — this file is NOT a substitute for the current state-wise RTO notification and must not be treated as legal advice.

SPEEDING.notes: Light Motor Vehicle range shown; fines for medium/heavy passenger and goods vehicles are typically higher under state notifications.

DANGEROUS_DRIVING.notes: May include imprisonment up to 1 year (first offense) / 2 years (subsequent) per the central Act; amounts here cover the monetary fine component only.

RED_LIGHT.notes: Often clubbed with Section 184 if the violation also endangered other road users.

OVERLOADING.notes: Plus INR 2,000 per additional tonne of excess load, per the central schedule.

NO_HELMET.notes: Also attracts a 3-month driving licence disqualification under the central Act.

WRONG_LANE.notes: General penalty provision; amount varies by state notification.

GENERAL.notes: Default/residual penalty for offences without a dedicated section.
